# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v5.3.0

这一版把「层级浏览」从**要用力看**改成**一眼分得清**。

起因是一个很具体的体感：在这个页面上，**分不清层级，也分不清哪些是领域、哪些是项目、哪些是事务**，得"用力"看才行。翻代码之后原因是清楚的——层级、类型、归属三件事几乎全压在**一个弱信号**上：

- 每层缩进只有 18px，而行首固定占着 20px 拖动柄 + 26px 展开箭头，标题起点已经在一百多像素开外，18px 的深度差不到基数的五分之一；
- 标题的字号字重**在所有深度完全一致**，层级在排版上根本没有被编码；
- 类型徽章是行内最抢眼的元素（1px 描边 + 13% 底色 + 彩色文字），却每行重复一次，而它想说的"类型"其实已经由位置表达了；
- 领域子树之间没有分隔线、没有留白、没有底色差，下一棵树直接接上来；
- 右侧今天是芯片墙：今日／切片计划／状态三套形状相同的小片长度不一，两套色板（类型色与状态色）并存。

结果就是「长期领域 · 写小说」和它第三层的「事务 · 第六章」在排版上完全一样，只能靠数像素判断自己在第几层。这一版把这三件事逐个拆开。

## 新增

- **章节块**：长期领域，以及不属于任何领域的顶层项目，各自成为一个包裹块 —— 描边 + 极淡底色 + **左侧一条贯通整块高度的角色色条**。领域下面的顶层项目也各自成块，于是「有几个领域、每个领域下有几个项目」一屏数得清。
- **块头吸顶**：滚动时领域头停在顶部，顶层项目头停在它下面，滚到第 30 行也知道自己在谁的子树里。
- **收起时给出块内规模**：折叠一个块，块头右侧显示「N 项目 · M 事务」，折叠态不再只剩一行标题。只数当前筛选下可见的后代，避免「今日」筛选里的数字和展开后对不上。
- **连续同值行自动淡化**：同一父下连续 3 行及以上「切片计划 + 状态」完全相同时，这些芯片整体降到 50% 不透明度 —— 「整理相册」那一列 8 个「未设切片／待开始」不再连成一堵墙。今日行不参与，避免把当天真要动手的事淡化掉。

## 变更

- **缩进与导引线**：每层缩进改为 24px 并由子容器承载，同时画出竖向导引线；导引线**按子节点分段绘制**，子节点本身是块（有色条）的那一段不再画线——贯通整块的色条已经承担了「这一支从这里起」的功能，两条并排只是重复。
- **排版分级**：按角色分四档 —— 领域 15px/700、顶层项目 13.5px/650、子项目 13px/600、事务与想法 13px/400 且用降一级的文字色；行高依次 46 / 40 / 36 / 34px，纵向有了节奏。
- **事务徽章收成小色点**：事务与想法行不再挂完整药丸，改成 7px 角色色圆点——保留类型身份，不再跟标题抢位置。徽章元素与读屏文本都保留，领域／顶层项目／子项目的实心徽章不变。
- **右列三列定宽对齐**：今日 44px、切片计划 84px、状态 66px，空槽保留宽度，于是整列垂直对齐、可以一列扫读「今天要做什么」。依赖芯片 `⇠N` 从标题与右列之间挪到标题左侧，「已移出今日」挪到状态列右侧。
- **「未设切片」降级**：缺省态不再画成彩色方片，只留淡灰文字（槽位保留，不影响对齐）。
- **同级行分隔线**：行与行之间加一条 1px 淡分隔线，连续多个事务不再糊成一片。
- **拖动柄与排序按钮按需出现**：`⠿` 与 `↑ ↓` 默认隐形，悬停、选中或键盘聚焦时才显示。位置一直留着，不会引起布局跳动。
- **窄屏四档收紧**：1100 / 980 / 760 / 620px 逐档收窄缩进与三列宽度，620px 以下隐藏子项目徽章；触屏设备行高统一抬到 42px（块头 48px），保证可点尺寸。

## 数据

- **不改任何数据**：本次只改渲染与两个派生计算，工作项、每日记录、清单、营养四份数据结构与存储版本号全部不变，无需迁移。
- 新增的两个派生值都从既有数据实时算出，不落盘：连续同值判定读「切片计划 + 状态」，块内计数读子树结构与类型。

## 验证

- `pnpm test`：648 passed / 5 skipped（58 文件通过／3 跳过；另有 1 项按设计在周一自动跳过，与本次改动无关）；`pnpm run check`：0 errors / 0 warnings。
- 新增 10 个回归：连续同值段的边界（3 行起、2 行不算、状态或切片计划不同即断开、不跨父连段、今日行既不入段也断开前后段、顶层兄弟同样适用），折叠计数的跨层统计与「只数可见后代」；组件层新增一条契约测试，锁住块容器带 `data-role`、依赖芯片在标题之前、事务徽章仍在、`data-repeat` 标记与「1 项目 · 3 事务」计数。
- 动手之前先出了可点击的设计稿（真实 `dist/index.css` + `TreeNode.svelte` 标记结构），覆盖四档宽度与七种残缺状态（空数据、全部折叠、领域下没有项目、今日筛选、超长标题、无状态、深色主题）；实现之后用同一套稿子逐帧复核了构建产物。
- 构建与 `package.zip` 校验通过；由推送 `v5.3.0` 标签触发 GitHub Actions 发布。

## 升级提示

- 升级后重新加载插件即可，无需迁移数据；数据文件一个字节都不会动。
- 想要更紧凑（顶层项目不再单独成块），把 `src/index.scss` 里 `.xz-tree-node[data-depth="1"][data-role="topProject"]` 两条规则去掉即可；每层缩进与块头高度由 `--xz-tree-indent`、`--xz-tree-block-head` 两个变量控制。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v5.3.0

This release takes hierarchy browsing from **something you have to squint at** to **something you can read at a glance**.

It started from a concrete feeling: on this page you **could not tell the levels apart, nor which were areas, which projects, and which transactions** — it took deliberate effort to read. The code explained why: level, type, and belonging were all carried by **one weak signal**.

- Each level indented only 18px, while every row spent a fixed 20px drag handle plus a 26px expand arrow before the title even began — the title started past a hundred pixels, so an 18px depth step was under a fifth of the offset.
- Titles used **exactly the same size and weight at every depth**; the hierarchy was not encoded in the typography at all.
- The type badge was the loudest element in the row (1px outline, 13% fill, coloured text) and yet repeated on every single line — while the "type" it announced was already expressed by position.
- Nothing separated one area's subtree from the next: no divider, no gap, no change of fill. The next tree simply continued.
- The right-hand side was a wall of chips: Today, slice plan, and status all sharing one shape at differing widths, with two colour systems (type and status) running side by side.

The result was that "Long-term area · Writing fiction" and a third-level "Transaction · Chapter six" looked typographically identical, leaving you to count pixels to work out your depth. This release pulls those three problems apart one by one.

## Added

- **Chapter blocks**: a long-term area, or a top-level project belonging to no area, becomes a wrapped block — outline, faint fill, and **a role-coloured strip running down its entire left edge**. Top-level projects nested under an area become blocks of their own too, so "how many areas, and how many projects inside each" can be counted in a single screen.
- **Sticky block headers**: while scrolling, the area header stays at the top and a nested project header parks directly beneath it, so row 30 still tells you whose subtree you are reading.
- **Collapsed blocks report their size**: folding a block shows "N projects · M transactions" in its header, so a collapsed block is no longer a bare title. Only descendants visible under the current filter are counted, so the Today filter never disagrees with what expanding reveals.
- **Consecutive identical rows fade back**: when three or more siblings in a row share exactly the same slice plan and status, their chips drop to 50% opacity — the eight "no slices yet / Not started" rows in the photo-album list stop forming a wall. Today rows are excluded so work you actually mean to do today is never dimmed.

## Changed

- **Indentation and guide lines**: each level now indents 24px, carried by the child container, and draws a vertical guide line. The guide is drawn **per child node**, and the segment beside a block — which already has a strip — is skipped: a strip running the full height of a block already says "this branch starts here", so two parallel lines would only repeat it.
- **A four-step type scale**: area 15px/700, top-level project 13.5px/650, subproject 13px/600, transaction and idea 13px/400 in a slightly recessed text colour. Row heights follow at 46 / 40 / 36 / 34px, giving the list a vertical rhythm.
- **Transaction badges become dots**: transaction and idea rows no longer carry a full pill but a 7px role-coloured dot — the type identity stays, the competition with the title goes. The badge element and its screen-reader text are both kept, and areas, top-level projects, and subprojects keep their solid badges.
- **Three fixed-width right-hand columns**: Today 44px, slice plan 84px, status 66px. Empty slots keep their width, so each column aligns vertically and "what am I doing today" can be read down a single column. The dependency chip `⇠N` moves from between the title and the columns to the left of the title, and "moved out of today" moves to the right of the status column.
- **"No slices yet" is demoted**: the default state is no longer a coloured chip, only faint grey text (its slot is kept so alignment is unaffected).
- **Sibling dividers**: a 1px hairline between rows, so consecutive transactions no longer blur into one another.
- **Drag handle and reorder buttons appear on demand**: `⠿` and `↑ ↓` are hidden until you hover, select, or keyboard-focus the row. Their space stays reserved, so nothing jumps when they appear.
- **Four narrow-width steps**: 1100 / 980 / 760 / 620px progressively tighten the indent and the three columns, and below 620px the subproject badge is hidden. On touch devices every row is raised to a 42px target (48px for block headers).

## Data

- **No data changes**: this release only touches rendering and two derived calculations. Work items, daily records, checklist, and nutrition keep their exact structures and storage version, and no migration is needed.
- Both new derived values are computed from existing data on the fly and never written to disk: the identical-row test reads the slice plan plus status, and the block count reads the subtree structure and types.

## Verification

- `pnpm test`: 648 passed / 5 skipped (58 files passed, 3 skipped; one further test skips itself on Mondays by design and is unrelated to this change); `pnpm run check`: 0 errors / 0 warnings.
- Ten new regressions: the boundaries of an identical run (three rows count, two do not, a differing status or slice plan breaks it, runs never cross parents, a today row neither joins a run nor lets one continue across it, and top-level siblings behave the same), plus cross-level and visible-only block counting. A component-level contract test locks down that the block container carries `data-role`, the dependency chip precedes the title, the transaction badge is still rendered, and `data-repeat` and the "1 project · 3 transactions" count both appear.
- Before writing any code, clickable design pages were rendered from the real `dist/index.css` and `TreeNode.svelte` markup, covering four widths and seven partial states (empty data, fully collapsed, an area with no projects, the Today filter, an over-long title, a missing status, and dark theme). After the implementation, the same pages were used frame by frame to re-check the built output.
- Build and `package.zip` verification pass; publishing is triggered by pushing the `v5.3.0` tag through GitHub Actions.

## Upgrade notes

- Just reload the plugin after upgrading; no data migration is required and no data file is touched.
- For a denser tree (top-level projects no longer becoming blocks of their own), delete the two `.xz-tree-node[data-depth="1"][data-role="topProject"]` rules in `src/index.scss`. Indent and header height are controlled by the `--xz-tree-indent` and `--xz-tree-block-head` variables.
